title: The vague Services page
situation: A colleague asked the AI for a Services page for a client, Bram's Plumbing, and got something useless. Bram is a local plumber in Utrecht: emergency repairs 24/7, boiler installation and servicing, leak detection, bathroom renovations.
goal: Fix the prompt so the AI writes a page Bram can actually publish.

details.label: Who the AI should be
details.hint: Who should the AI be? A web copywriter writes pages that sell.

details.label: A Services page
details.hint: What should it write? A Services page for the website.

details.label: Who the client is
details.hint: Who is the client? Name Bram's Plumbing.

details.label: The services to list
details.hint: Which services? List them: emergency repairs, boilers, leak detection, bathrooms.

details.label: Where Bram works
details.hint: Where does Bram work? Local customers search by town: Utrecht.

details.label: The tone
details.hint: What tone? Trustworthy and clear: people call a plumber when something's wrong.

details.label: Length and structure
details.hint: What shape? Say how long and how it's organised, like a short intro plus one section per service.

details.label: An example to follow
details.hint: Bonus: paste a page you like, so the AI can follow its pattern.

details.label: A rule to respect
details.hint: Bonus: add a rule, like don't invent prices.

conflicts.explain: Short and very detailed at the same time? The roof cracks. Pick one length.

answers.vague:
Our Services

We offer a wide range of high-quality services to meet all your needs. Our team is dedicated to excellence and customer satisfaction. Contact us today to learn more about what we can do for you.
answers.passable:
Our Services

Bram's Plumbing offers plumbing services including repairs, boilers and bathrooms. We are experienced and reliable. Contact us for more information.
answers.excellent:
Plumbing services in Utrecht: Bram's Plumbing

A leak at midnight or a cold shower on Monday morning? Bram is a local plumber who answers the phone.

Emergency repairs, 24/7: burst pipes, blocked drains, no hot water.
Boilers: installation and yearly servicing.
Leak detection: we find the source without breaking walls.
Bathroom renovations: from plan to last tile.

Call Bram for a free quote.

ada.intro: Level 3: this prompt gave the answer you see. The building collapsed. Can you fix it?
ada.success: Now it holds! Same request, but with the client, the services, the area and the shape. The page is ready to publish.
ada.takeaway: You don't fix a vague prompt by rewording it. You fix it by adding what the AI can't know.
